authorization_basis: GOAL.controller.new_segment_allocation and current coordinator assignment. This is a fresh finite allocation carrying all prior usage, not reuse of spent prelaunch reservations.

predecessor.preparation_binding: Bind the actual independent runtime-abort review and incident SHA. Accept this exact abrupt-stop evidence as its own input type, not as a substitute manufactured RETURN or a completed predecessor.

starting_state.parity_rule: Checkpoint bytes are authoritative. Use unchanged Driver::read_checkpoint to recover exact binary64 state, all 392 stocks, 24 ledgers, counters and original initial-energy reference. Compare complete decoded state, not only selected scalars in this readable summary. No rounding, resampling, counter reset or clock/energy rebasing.

physical_and_numerical_policy.policy: All physical fields and numerical controls in the frozen config are unchanged: source, IC, geometry, rates, closures, energy/angle grids, adaptive tolerance, Newton policy, rejection limits, conservation tolerances and every-accepted-step invariant checks. Only execution resource overrides, input terminal type and output identity change.
physical_and_numerical_policy.reader_checks: Retain exact original background time/b and initial-energy checks, shape checks, next-step domain, gas admission and Driver.validate(state,1e-8). Do not weaken the reader to accept this checkpoint.
physical_and_numerical_policy.energy_ledgers: Keep the zbar20 initial-energy reference and cumulative ledgers; no local segment energy zero or reconstructed instantaneous rates from accumulated ledgers.
physical_and_numerical_policy.output_boundary: First new history/abundance/full-spectrum/ledger row represents the exact saved checkpoint. Mark it as an interrupted-checkpoint boundary, not predecessor terminal completion.

source_compatibility.implementation: Link the already-reviewed library from signed_continuation_001/repair_001/target/release/deps, recording its actual rlib SHA and verifying exported compiled_identity equals the approved identity. Copy the reviewed run_segment execution/output loop into a new owned Rust entrypoint; change only PLUS case admission, segment/boundary metadata, explicit resource binding, and interrupted-checkpoint input admission. No existing example or library source changes.
source_compatibility.identity_rule: Record old binary, old library identity, reviewed resource-only library identity, new wrapper source SHA and actual new binary SHA separately. Do not claim the new executable is byte-identical to the old binary. Stop on any additional scientific module change or unreviewed library identity.

new_allocation.effective_trajectory_max_wall_s_rule: Exactly decoded starting state.wall_elapsed_s + 9000.0 in binary64; bind resulting value. Approximate decimal16347.101283315. Preserve state.wall_elapsed_s itself unchanged.
new_allocation.rule: Trajectory counters continue from checkpoint and stop at these absolute ceilings. Fresh execution cost is additionally charged even when repeating unsaved work. State counters alone do not claim complete cost accounting for the aborted tail.

cumulative_costs.prior_unsaved_tail_work: UNKNOWN; retain separate from exactly saved trajectory counters
cumulative_costs.interpretation: These are finite conservative accounting envelopes using the entire prior continuation allocation, not measured work or new trajectory caps. Preserve measured original, saved and observer costs alongside them; never label unknown CPU/tail as zero. Retain prior prelaunch launcher charges separately.
cumulative_costs.campaign_rule: Reconcile actual current counters before reservation; unrelated authorized starts, including AX11, add rather than replace these counts. Prior allocations and output bytes remain preserved and charged.

paths.path_prefix_meaning: 4de69c1e68eb denotes approved compiled-library identity, not new wrapper binary SHA.
paths.preserved: Entire original PLUS and interrupted continuation, all original raw/receipts, classifier packages and active HALF_PLUS are read-only. No in-place resume or deletion. New output/raw must be absent before the sole exclusive reservation.

required_checks: Read real frozen checkpoint with reviewed library, export full decoded state, check all fields, clock, 392 stocks,24 ledgers and initial-energy reference exactly. No advance.

Exercise binding/guard acceptance for exact abrupt-stop receipt and absent RETURN, and refusal for changed checkpoint/config/source/q_ref, wrong initial energy or clock, reset counters, existing output/raw, duplicate reservation and changed caps. Use copied manufactured input for negative checks; never edit predecessor.

Confirm copied run_segment loop has no numerical changes and retains charged failed-step counters, checkpoint/output budgeting, initial and terminal full spectrum and existing sparse spectrum cadence. New boundary metadata must not say predecessor completed.

Actual new binary/interface and full execution binding/argv are frozen after build; proposed --binding/--binding-sha256 interface is implementation work, not an assertion that an executable already exists.

launch_gate: Fresh independent changed-surface review accepts wrapper, source relation, actual checkpoint parity, complete binding and targeted raw results. No mandatory new continuum proof or whole science review.
Classifier repair and owner-coverage amendment have scoped PASS if launcher uses that adapter. Any standalone launcher must use the same reviewed classifier; do not invoke old broad-token scanners.

Old interrupted observer/solver groups are absent with start identities checked, and no pending competing PLUS reservation exists. Preserve historical attempts2/start1 and reserve attempt3 before Popen.

Observe live HALF_PLUS and all local/remote/pending allocations. At most two total science slots; this segment may share the second slot with independent HALF_PLUS, with no old exclusive dispatcher handoff imposed on it. If occupied, wait without charging a solver attempt.

Record current available CPU affinity, one permitted CPU, memory at least2GiB for this additional slot and sufficient disk for new4GiB envelope plus margin. Bind time/timeout/taskset/prlimit outer argv and exact env thread counts.

Record immutable identities again immediately before sole Popen, acknowledge PID/PGID/start time, and monitor only exact owned process identity with reviewed classifier. Bound total wall/RSS/aggregate outputs, not only per-file size.

composition.rule: Compose original PLUS prefix, interrupted continuation only through frozen checkpoint.a inclusive, then new segment strictly after its duplicated initial boundary. Deduplicate each boundary once by exact state/epoch; retain every raw file unchanged.
composition.unsaved_suffix: Any old rows beyond frozen checkpoint are preserved as aborted unselected suffix and excluded from the selected trajectory; do not interleave them with resumed results or erase their execution costs.
composition.requirements: Verify matching checkpoint boundary in saved history and consistency of time/abundance/spectral/ledger records. Preserve original proper time and cumulative initial-energy reference. If a necessary prefix interval is missing, state the precise missing rows and retain scoped recovery output; never manufacture a history. Recompute composed feedback diagnostics using actual selected prefix and suffix.
composition.terminal: New actual terminal RETURN and external execution result belong only to the new output. Completion requires endpoint and full composed-data review; execution permission is not science admission.

stopping: First input/source/identity ambiguity, preparation check failure or out-of-scope change stops preparation with a concrete finding. During the one authorized scientific run, endpoint or first existing numerical/resource/output guard stops and preserves checkpoint/raw result. No automatic restart, replay, second new start or repair is authorized by this file.
